rules.USED_FOR: The source explicitly attributes performance, use, or a stated objective to this local method actor for this literal task. Includes background method use, training proxy, component operation and downstream application, with mandatory role metadata. Do not propagate a whole-model claim to its family or components; indirect contribution or co-occurrence alone is UNRESOLVED.
rules.EVALUATED_ON: Explicit source-local evaluation of the named method or strategy on the named dataset. Training data, initialization sources and component participation do not establish evaluation.
rules.NO_RELATION: Requires evidence denying this attributed use/evaluation at the task scope, not merely assignment of another direct executor. All five inherited operator-role contrasts remain review labels but are quarantined from ordinary RE targets pending scope adjudication.
rules.METHOD: Literal model/algorithm families, named models, technical architectural components, training or augmentation procedures; include negated method mentions for NER without implying use. Exclude parameter values, metrics, tensor objects and unqualified anaphoric generic model/component references.
rules.TASK: Literal research operations/objectives, including explicit action phrases and context-resolved inpainting mentions. Exclude bare application domains, data/modalities, intermediate output objects and performance metrics; do not invent an operation from an output noun.
rules.DATASET: Literal named datasets, regardless of training/evaluation role. No inferred benchmark from a title or link.
rules.migration: Preserve every prior mention and judgment via (start,end,text,label) anchors; assign contiguous source-order IDs after additions. Enumerate all legal pairs again, leave all added pairs UNRESOLVED.
rules.export: Source, roles, support groups, predicate spans and attribution are audit metadata, not features available at prediction time. Partial known-pair export is NOT document-complete RE supervision. No default admission to V1 trainers.
